Web · /board-sizes

Board Sizes: content types and a calmer UI

Pick a piece of content and see every board it needs; share a link with no way back to the site; export sizes, CSV or an After Effects script. Restyled from blueprint to a quiet, document-like app.

content types: 4 broad (draft) + 27 game-day from Colosseum

31

distinct canvases for a Touchdown (54 placements)

28

tests passing (with QR Studio: 40)

36

Screens (after only)

Static page at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844; light unless noted.

What changed, and why

No way to see what a piece of content needs

Was

You had to know which boards to build for.

Now

Content types in the sidebar: our four broad types (marked draft) and Colosseum’s 27 game-day pieces, grouped Scoring, Noise, Plays, Living holds, Moments.

Sharing sent people into the site

Was

A link included the Tools navigation.

Now

“Share link” copies a URL with share=1; that view has no link back to the site.

Setting up AE by hand

Was

Type each comp size.

Now

“AE comps” downloads a .jsx that creates one named comp per distinct canvas at the right size, frame rate and duration.

Blueprint styling

Was

Heavy blue grid, outlined display type.

Now

System type, hairlines, light/dark, sidebar navigation; drawings kept.
